title: Pure Ice Barrier
summary: Ice Barrier cards with Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain, Icejade Gymir Aegirine, and generic staples. Ice Barrier combines floodgate monsters that lock the opponent while another Ice Barrier is on the field with a Synchro engine led by Revealer, Mirror Mage, and Georgius.

summary.title: Starters
points: Medallion of the Ice Barrier adds any Ice Barrier monster from the Deck to the hand with no once-per-turn limit.

Revealer of the Ice Barrier discards 1 card to Special Summon an Ice Barrier Tuner from the Deck (locking you into WATER Special Summons for the turn), and banishes itself from the GY in place of a discard cost for an Ice Barrier effect.

Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier Tributes 1 other effect monster (or a Token) to summon up to 3 Ice Barrier Tokens and raise its Level by up to 3, then searches any Ice Barrier card or banished Ice Barrier when sent to the GY.
Georgius, Swordman of the Ice Barrier Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an Ice Barrier, then summons a Level 5 or lower Ice Barrier from your hand or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Revealer of the Ice Barrier + 1 Card
steps: Normal Summon Revealer of the Ice Barrier and discard 1 card to Special Summon Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier from the Deck.
Activate Mirror Mage's effect, Tributing Revealer to Special Summon 3 Level 1 Ice Barrier Tokens (raising Mirror Mage to Level 5).

Tune Mirror Mage (Level 2 + 3 = 5) with 1 or 2 Tokens, or search Speaker for the Ice Barriers / Georgius when Mirror Mage goes to the GY, climbing into Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain (Level 10) and setting Frozen Domain of the Ice Barrier via General Wayne.

summary.title: Bosses & Floodgate Locks
points: Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain Special Summons an Ice Barrier monster from your hand, Deck, Extra Deck, or GY up to twice per turn whenever the opponent Special Summons—dropping Georgius (stops opponent's GY monster activations), General Wayne (banishes Spells/Traps sent from field to GY), or Revealer (stops Tribute Summons)—and floats into Trishula, Zero Dragon of the Ice Barrier if it leaves the field.
Trishula, Zero Dragon of the Ice Barrier banishes up to 3 cards the opponent controls on Synchro Summon (Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier is Forbidden since October 2026).
Icejade Gymir Aegirine protects your monsters from destruction and banishment by opponent's effects, while Brionac, Gungnir, and Dewloren clear boards at Levels 6 and 7.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Frozen Domain of the Ice Barrier prevents the opponent from responding to your Ice Barrier monster effects and returns a card on the field to the hand or Deck when an Extra Deck monster is Special Summoned.

Winds Over the Ice Barrier Tributes any number of Ice Barriers to Special Summon that many Level 4 or lower Ice Barriers with different names from the Deck, and Freezing Chains of the Ice Barrier revives a Level 4 or lower Ice Barrier.
Terror of Trishula applies up to three banish effects based on the number of Ice Barrier Synchro Monsters with different names you control.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier is not yet released in the TCG.
